title: Accounts Payable Analyst I
description:
Accounts Payable Analyst I 
 
 Job Summary 
 Provide end-to-end support for the Accounts Payable and invoice processing process, ensuring timely and accurate processing of invoices and related transactions in SAP. The role is responsible for maintaining accurate Accounts Payable records, supporting timely supplier payments, meeting agreed service levels, complying with internal controls, and providing quality service to internal and external customers. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Receive, review, validate, process, and confirm invoices, debit notes, credit notes, and invoice provisions for purchases and expenses related to goods and services. Ensure documentation is complete, accurate, and contains the required approvals before processing transactions in SAP. Register invoices, debit notes, and credit notes daily by performing the appropriate SAP transactions to maintain timely and accurate Accounts Payable records. Meet agreed service levels for GBS Finance LAO customers, ensuring timely and quality delivery based on customer requirements. Review Purchase Orders associated with invoices and validate goods receipts and service acceptances to ensure compliance with three-way matching / triple validation requirements. Ensure supplier payment terms are correctly followed in accordance with company guidelines and support timely payment processing. Review and release authorized pre-registered invoices for accounting and payment after validating the required information. Provide documentation and information required by supported countries for audits, filing, analysis, and other Accounts Payable-related activities. Respond to inquiries from internal and external customers and provide guidance relating to processes, systems, documentation, and Accounts Payable requirements. Ensure activities are performed in accordance with applicable internal controls, data management requirements, and established procedures. Comply with applicable safety, health, environmental, loss-control, and regulatory requirements. Actively participate in and support continuous improvement and development initiatives promoted by the organization. Ensure compliance with established quality requirements, with a focus on meeting the expectations of internal and external customers. Support integration and implementation activities involving GBS services and customers. Provide SAP and process support for implementation projects and new team members, including process training where required. Participate in system updates and changes to SAP processes required by local or corporate markets. Support the creation, review, and updating of process manuals and standard operating procedures. 
 
 Functional / Business Skills 
 To succeed in this role, you will need the ability to: Maintain accurate records and controls for the companys Accounts Payable activities to support timely supplier payments. Maintain reliable information within financial systems to support reporting and business decision-making. Deliver quality and customer-focused service to supported markets and stakeholders. Follow established systems, controls, procedures, and quality standards within the Accounts Payable function. Use SAP Finance functionality to process and record transactions related to Accounts Payable. Work with Vendor Invoice Management (VIM) or similar invoice management solutions for the receipt, control, and registration of supplier payment documents. Apply knowledge of financial controls, accounting controls, performance metrics, financial systems, and continuous improvement within Accounts Payable processes. Identify, investigate, and resolve routine Accounts Payable issues in a timely manner. Develop strong expertise in AP transaction processing and share process knowledge with colleagues when required. Work accurately in a transaction-driven environment while meeting agreed timelines and service levels. 
 
 About You 
 You are detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable working with financial transactions and systems. You understand the importance of accuracy and timeliness when processing invoices and supporting supplier payments. You bring: Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Good analytical and problem-solving abilities. A customer-focused mindset. Ability to organize and prioritize work effectively. Willingness to learn new processes and systems. Ability to collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders. Strong sense of ownership and accountability. Interest in continuous improvement and developing expertise in Accounts Payable. 
 
 Key / Required Qualifications and Experience 
 Degree in Business Administration, Finance, Commerce, Accounting, or a related field. 2-5 years of relevant experience, preferably in Accounts Payable, Finance Operations, Accounting, or a related area. Basic understanding of Accounts Payable and accounting processes. Ability to work with invoices, purchase orders, financial documentation, and transaction data. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy. 
 
 Other Requirements 
 Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills. Knowledge of SAP is desirable. Exposure to SAP Finance / Accounts Payable functionality is an advantage. Knowledge or exposure to VIM (Vendor Invoice Management) is desirable. English proficiency is desirable. 
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Previous internship, apprenticeship, or professional exposure to Accounts Payable, Finance Operations, or Accounting. Exposure to invoice processing, purchase orders, goods receipts, service entries, or three-way matching. Exposure to a GBS, Shared Services, or Finance Operations environment. Basic understanding of financial controls and audit requirements. Experience using SAP, ERP, or invoice management systems. Customer-service orientation with the ability to work effectively with internal and external stakeholders. Strong learning agility and willingness to build expertise in Accounts Payable processes.

title: Associate Payroll Manager
description:
Job Description 
 Position: Associate Manager-Payroll 
 Department: Human Resources
 Location: Pune
 Reporting To: Head of C&B & HR Operations 
 Experience: 5 to 10 years (depending on role level)
 
The role is responsible for managing end-to-end payroll operations through ZingHR, statutory compliance, and payroll accounting, ensuring accurate and timely salary processing, adherence to applicable labour laws and statutory regulations, and proper accounting and reconciliation of payroll-related costs and liabilities.
 
The incumbent will coordinate with HR, Finance, Accounts, Taxation, Internal Audit, and external payroll vendors to ensure payroll accuracy, financial integrity, regulatory compliance, and adherence to established processes and controls.
 
The role requires a strong focus on payroll accuracy, statutory compliance, accounting reconciliations, audit readiness, and payroll cost reporting, ensuring efficient execution of payroll operations and timely closure of payroll-related activities.
 
 Required Qualifications, Experience & Competencies 
 Graduate/Postgraduate in Finance, Commerce, HR, or a related discipline; relevant professional qualifications or payroll certifications preferred. 5 to 10 years of experience in payroll operations, statutory compliance, and payroll accounting, preferably in a large or multi-location organization. Strong knowledge of Indian payroll legislation, labour laws, statutory deductions, and employee taxation. Hands-on experience in payroll journal entries, GL and balance sheet reconciliations, provisions, and month-end financial closing. Experience managing large employee populations, multiple legal entities, complex salary structures, and payroll vendors. Working knowledge of HRMS/payroll systems, preferably ZingHR or equivalent. Advanced MS Excel skills, including data analysis, complex calculations, MIS reporting, dashboard preparation, and reconciliation. Strong numerical aptitude, analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret payroll data accurately. Excellent stakeholder management and coordination skills, with high standards of accuracy, confidentiality, integrity, and attention to detail. Ability to manage strict timelines, multiple priorities, internal controls, compliance risks, vendor coordination, and continuous process improvement. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. End-to-End Payroll Management & MIS Reporting 
 Execute accurate and timely monthly payroll processing, including attendance, leave, fixed/variable pay, incentives, arrears, reimbursements, deductions, and full and final settlements. Validate employee master data, salary structures, CTC revisions, increments, promotions, transfers, exits, and payroll inputs. Coordinate with HR, Regional HR, Operations, and Finance for timely payroll inputs and approvals. Prepare monthly payroll MIS covering headcount, payroll costs, net salary, statutory costs, deductions, and other employee expenses; support budgeting, forecasting, accruals, and management reporting. Track statutory liabilities, payroll provisions, unreconciled balances, and outstanding payments; drive payroll automation and process improvements. Ensure timely Full and Final (F&F) settlement and closure for exiting employees. Respond to and resolve queries raised by internal stakeholders promptly. 
 2. Statutory Compliance & Taxation 
 Ensure timely compliance with PF, ESIC, PT, LWF, TDS, gratuity, and other applicable statutory requirements. Monitor changes in labour laws, wage definitions, statutory limits, contribution rates, and tax regulations, assessing their impact on payroll and employee costs. Coordinate statutory calculations, reconciliations, payments, returns, and filings within prescribed timelines. Manage employee tax declarations, investment proofs, tax calculations, TDS deductions, and annual payroll tax activities. Maintain a statutory compliance calendar and ensure timely compliance across locations and legal entities. 
 3. Payroll Accounting & Financial Reconciliation 
 Prepare and post payroll journal entries, ensuring accurate accounting of salaries, benefits, deductions, statutory liabilities, and payroll provisions in the General Ledger (GL). Reconcile payroll registers, payroll summaries, bank payments, GL balances, and statutory liabilities, investigating and resolving discrepancies. Ensure accurate accounting of advances, loans, reimbursements, incentives, bonuses, arrears, recoveries, and full and final settlements. Review payroll provisions, including variable pay, bonus, gratuity, and leave encashment, in coordination with Finance. Ensure accurate cost allocation across cost centres, business units, locations, and legal entities. Support monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing, including accruals, reversals, reclassifications, balance sheet schedules, and timely closure of outstanding accounting items. 
 4. Audit, Controls & Governance 
 Ensure adherence to internal policies, financial controls, approval workflows, and delegation of authority. Maintain complete audit trails and documentation for payroll inputs, changes, approvals, payments, statutory filings, and accounting entries. Coordinate internal, statutory, financial, and payroll compliance audits, providing required records and supporting timely closure of audit observations.
